decisions.reason: The source limits daily social publishing to a specific Meta account; it does not change product publication on the Coastal Bazaar Picks website.
The Meta-account instruction changes where daily social posts are published, not the creation or Google Drive storage of the content bank.
The source concerns access to and work within a Meta account, not product listing or publication through CJ Dropshipping on TikTok Shop.
Selecting products from CJ Dropshipping is unaffected by the temporary Meta-account context for daily social publishing.
The instruction does not alter which sourced products must be recorded in the product catalog list or how they are tracked.
The Meta-account scope change is unrelated to the deferred HubSpot contact-property configuration requirement.
